name: Discrete k-d tree isosurface extraction
aliases: Direct Isosurface Extraction from Scattered Volume Data
definition: Extracts an isosurface from a scalar field by traversing a discrete k-d tree hierarchy along contour edges, refining nodes until contouring leaves are found, then generating quads.
summary: Discrete k-d tree isosurface extraction extracts isosurfaces from scattered volume data by interpolating between neighbors, avoiding grid construction and running faster than Delaunay tetrahedrization.
